instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\bracket_seed.dxf. Import bracket_seed.dxf. Draw a reinforced right-angle bracket with L outline vertices (0,0), (130,0), (130,25), (35,25), (35,100), and (0,100), add a diagonal CENTER gusset line from (35,25) to (100,0), add holes at (95,12.5) and (17.5,75) with radius 5, and add text ACAD-25. Use OUTLINE for the bracket outline, CENTER for the gusset line, HOLE for holes, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
